description: Comfortable one-level living in the desirable Jackson View Estates neighborhood of Chehalis—with no HOA! This inviting 3-bedroom home features an open floor plan with two living spaces, a kitchen with breakfast bar that opens to the guest entertainment room, and a great room also. Spacious primary bedroom with a ¾ bath and two closets. Many important updates have already been completed, including a new roof in 2019, windows in 2021, heat pump and furnace in 2021, and updated kitchen appliances in 2021/2022. The backyard was improved in 2025 with a patio and retaining wall, creating an easy-to-enjoy outdoor space. Generous RV and off-street parking, along with a clean, finished garage, add to the convenience. Located just a few blocks from the 27-hole Newaukum Valley Golf Course, this well-maintained home is ready for its next owner!
